use_case_summary: MergeBotica builds a GitHub-style PR assistant that summarizes diffs, suggests inline comments, and ranks suggested changes. Key requirements: sub-100ms token latency for streaming summaries in the IDE, deterministic reranking so suggestions are stable across reviewers, and model/version pinning for reproducible CI checks.

Model pinning & canary rollouts per repo/team
Prefix/KV caching for repeated file headers and license headers
Embedding-based reranking for comment relevance (on top of LM suggestions)
Support for dataset retention controls and audit log forwarding
